encounters.mechanics:
Deepdark Ward: The boss moves to the center and creates a ward worth 45% of its Max HP. Only elemental and reaction damage reduces it; Physical damage does not. Lunar Reaction damage deals 3 times its normal damage to the ward.
Fishers: Four appear during the charge. Each defeated Fisher removes 25% of the boss's ward, so defeating all four can break it without directly attacking the boss.
